title: What a Vacation Package Still Owes and the Instalment Called On It
content:
The instalment called on a vacation package is what the package still owes, called in one payment. This sheet records how the packages pricing team arrives at that figure on a package sold under any of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products.

## 1. The priced package value

The priced package value the call is worked out on is the package price recorded on the package. A traveller's share of the package price is the package price divided by the travellers the package records as travelling.

## 2. Concession rates standing against the call

Concession rates standing against the call are first added into one combined rate, and the priced package value is reduced once by that combined rate; two such rates never act one after the other. The combined rate reduces the priced package value alone.

## 3. What the package still owes

What the package still owes is that priced package value, together with every component, supplement, penalty and amendment charge standing on the package ledger, less every deposit and every instalment already taken on the package. Anything falling due with this call as a deposit difference is added to what the package still owes.

The charges standing on the package ledger and anything falling due as a deposit difference are added to the reduced priced package value; the deposits and the instalments already taken are subtracted last of all.

## 4. The instalment called

The instalment called is the whole of what the package still owes, rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point. The rounding is applied once the figure is complete and at no earlier point in the working.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package whose recorded price is 6,000.00 USD, recording 4 travellers, gives a traveller's share of 1,500.00 USD. Its ledger carries components of 450.00 USD and a penalty of 120.00 USD, being 570.00 USD of charges standing against it, and it has taken a deposit of 800.00 USD and an instalment of 1,200.00 USD, being 2,000.00 USD already taken.

What the package still owes is 6,000.00 USD together with 570.00 USD, less 2,000.00 USD: 4,570.00 USD. The instalment called is the whole of that figure, 4,570.00 USD.
